== Summary ==
Decipher Star Wars CCG constructed tournament command card (scoresheet), © 1999 Decipher Inc., two cards per sheet. Compared with the 1997 card ([[:File:1998-commandcard-p1.png]]) it adds a Player ID line and drops the date, tournament director and final score lines.

Used on [[Tournaments]].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-8/84/Decipher-scorecard-constructed-p1.png Internet Archive item].
